property_summary: For any address that has been granted auth by rely, calling rely again increments its ward to 1 in the reference but leaves it unchanged in the mutant, which can be detected by checking wards[user] == 1 after rely.
change_summary: Change the require condition from wards[msg.sender] == 1 to wards[msg.sender] != 1, making any value other than 1 pass auth.
